basic_details.job_title: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 21 Cluster Supervisor & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Rural Livelihood Mission, Government of Karnataka (NRLM Karnataka) is recruiting candidates for 21 total vacancies, including District Manager - Farm Livelihood, Taluk Program Manager, Cluster Supervisor - Skill, Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods, and Block Manager - Non-Farm Livelihood posts. The place of posting for these positions is Mandya. Eligible candidates can apply online for this 2026 recruitment drive by visiting the official website and exploring open roles. The online application process starts on 14 October 2026, and the last date to apply online is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 open job calls and vacancies to fill across various positions in Mandya district.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available under NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Available posts include District Manager - Farm Livelihood, Taluk Program Manager, Cluster Supervisor - Skill, Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods, and Block Manager - Non-Farm Livelihood.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The job locations are across Mandya district, including taluks such as Mandya, Malavalli, Maddur, Krishnarajpet, and Shrirangapattana.
